findings.what:
The guard should be `n > 0`. With `n > 1`, line index 1 gets no preceding newline, so the first two lines are joined together: `"a
b
c"` becomes `"ab
  c"`. This breaks every multiline table message and the new tests.

Any existing message still written as `\n  ` with its own indent, such as a remedy line elsewhere in the crate, now gets a second two-space indent from the emitter, and the diff updates only the test message.
